contract: Actionable alt-data axis for the Mastermind bot. Each signal: signal_score 0-100 (composite of weighted convergence + brain conviction + price confirm − extension), action ∈ {ACCUMULATE,WATCH,AVOID}, direction ∈ {long,short,neutral}, source ∈ {brain,deterministic}. The bot sizes through its OWN risk framework; this is an input, not an order. Brain calls are graded vs SPY (see calibration).
